description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 199. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. 00-page-0.json holds page 0 for blocks 0 to 99, with a release. 01-invalid-utf8.json holds page 0 for blocks 100 to 199, with a refund, but the who string of the refund holds the byte 0xff, which is not valid UTF-8. Decoded lossily, the byte would become U+FFFD and the page would parse, so the census would come out complete with the refund counted. Page files are read as strict UTF-8 (clause 12), so the file cannot be read and refuses the whole census. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
